limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the two comparisons but asserted match one clock earlier than the correct fix and changed the shift-register reset value from all zeros to all ones.
The test shifted in the new bit before computing the expected output, so it validated the rewrite’s timing rather than checking that both comparisons used the pre-edge register contents.
